description: A sparse isolated field of twelve tiny pale warm cream and muted amber dust motes, distributed across a fully transparent 64x64 canvas. Every mote is only one or two native pixels. Brighter than the dim dust variant but not glowing. No light cone, light ray, cloud, lamp, object, floor or background. Strict native one-pixel-grid pixel art for DREAMS, a dark abandoned fast-food restaurant at 320x180 native resolution. Effect only, transparent background, hard opaque pixel clusters, limited supplied palette. No anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, blur, glow, drawn background lighting, characters, text, furniture or other objects. Static camera and fixed canvas; no zoom or global position/scale jitter. Canvas exactly 64x64 pixels.

reference_images.usage_description: Native pixel density and flat pixel rendering only. Create the requested different VFX, not this steam shape.
